*nat
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:DOCKER - [0:0]
-A PREROUTING -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
-A DOCKER -p tcp --dport 6379 -j DNAT --to-destination 172.18.0.2:6379
COMMIT
*filter
:INPUT DROP [0:0]
:FORWARD DROP [0:0]
:DOCKER - [0:0]
:DOCKER-USER - [0:0]
-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 6379 -j DROP
-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 5432 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -s 192.0.2.0/24 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -j DROP
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-USER
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER
-A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.2/32 -p tcp --dport 6379 -j ACCEPT
COMMIT
